kalshi_desc: Order-book collector live across ~250 markets: 1-second book snapshots + full depth deltas + trades. The morning network block ended; a REST backfill is recovering the blocked window’s trades.
spot_desc: Coinbase and Kraken trade history → 1-second bars, both legs running and unaffected by the Kalshi block.
events_desc: The ledger is accumulating on clean, validated inputs (proxy ±$4 vs official settlements) since ~11:05 MT. Events are raw candidates; the events→outcomes join after a few days of accumulation is the direct test of the second-scale dislocation thesis.

findings.text: The commodity cheap-tail claim. Gold/silver/WTI contracts at ≤15¢ with 2–5 min left resolve exactly as often as priced — flat per-market, −24% to −39% on risk after fees. 12,000 markets, 162k observations.

BTC dip-overshoot (+4.7z) died at the fill level. At the first tradeable touch the market is exactly right (6.8¢ cost, 6.7% win rate); the gap only existed against an average quote no order can obtain.

The market already prices the path. Conditional calibration by path state (20 cells, 25k observations): no cell deviates significantly — quoted ≈ realized everywhere. Trading empirical-vs-market disagreements out of sample: −9% to −12% on risk, t ≈ −4.4, at every threshold. When the similar-windows lookup disagrees with the quote, the quote is right.

The minute-scale version of the founding observation. The state is real — index above strike with the market below 50¢ happens in 4.3% of minutes — but when it happens, the book is right: realized outcomes track the quoted mid, not the index model, in every credible z-bucket (90 days, 82,669 rows). No manipulation-decay signature (fresh spikes settle like drifts: 50.0% vs 46.1%, CIs overlap), the market's mid out-forecasts the model (Brier 0.1631 vs 0.1663), and the fill-level threshold sweep is flat after fees. Four independent studies now agree: efficient at ≥1-minute granularity.

Cross-crypto lead-lag (BTC leads, alt quotes sticky). Six alt 15-min series (ETH, SOL, XRP, DOGE, BNB, HYPE) now in live book + 1s spot capture; 90-day histories backfilling. Coarse test: alt quotes conditioned on BTC's prior-2-min move, plus a fill-level backtest with BTC as placebo — runs the moment candles land. The seconds-scale version follows from live capture.

What remains: seconds. Every refutation used 1-minute data; dislocations lasting 3–30 seconds are structurally invisible to all of it. The live book capture, dislocation ledger, and paper desk are the only instruments that can see there — they accumulate the answer continuously.
